contexts.text: That the conjunction cannot come forth except in what is impure of man. Treated of.
The conjunction of the Lord with man in his impurity. Signified, Explained.
When these things are read... nothing but what is impure enters the ideas...
After there is no longer any affection of truth, a certain impure good, the good of falsity, infuses itself.
Man's first affection of truth is very impure. (Explained.)
Everything discordant is... impure, and is to be rejected. This Impure from discord is represented by what is impure with the blood and in the blood, from which it is to be defecated.
Thought about recompense... renders this love impure. Explained.

(Thus) the good of the Spiritual Church is impure; and, as it is impure, the spiritual cannot be admitted into Heaven, except by Divine means... But as the good with them is impure, they cannot but be infested by evils and falsities, and thus be in combat. But the Lord provides that by means of these combats what is impure with them is by degrees purified. Signified.

Before they can be elevated into Heaven... they are infested by the evils and falsities with them, to the end that they may be removed; for there are impure things which they have contracted in the life of the body, and which cannot possibly agree with Heaven...
I am of uncircumcised lips = that to them I am impure... as to the things of doctrine.
As everything impure is from impure loves, which are the love of the world and the love of self...
Hence the truths of doctrine are apperceived by them no otherwise than as impure: heavenly loves also appear to them as impure...
That the Divine Law is impure to those who are in falsities. Signified. AC 7245.
For the worship with that nation Mas impure. (Explained.)
To the impure all things are impure.
Marriages with the Israelitish nation were impure, because their interiors were filthy... Hence not to approach a woman = to abstain from what is impure.
He who is not regenerate... is always impure...
Man's corporeal natural love... has become impure from the separation from it of heavenly love with the parents. This love cannot be separated from its impurity, unless...
